method: As on 2026-10-25 and 2026-10-30: each board page read, its benchmarkViewUrl prop's hashed /_astro/benchmark_view_*.json downloaded (vals/<slug>.json, URL in vals/<slug>.jsonUrl.txt); values from tasks.overall.<model key>. Exact = same Vals model key (model version) and reasoning_effort/compute_effort equal to AA's effort, or, where AA plots no effort, the documented or owner-stated equivalent (O66, O135, O54/E252); plausible = AA plots no effort and Vals records none (MiMo-V2.6-Flash, O140); absent otherwise. Vals model pages for MiMo-V2.6-Pro and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash in vals/_models/ (read 2026-11-01T06:00:25Z).

mimo-v2-6-flash.note: Owner decision O135 (2026-10-30): AA plots MiMo-V2.6-Flash without an effort; Xiaomi's API documents a single thinking mode (thinking.type enabled/disabled, default enabled; on the Responses API every reasoning.effort other than none enables the same, undifferentiated reasoning), so the configuration is thinking enabled, the default (../../2026-10-30-v5-recapture/third-party/mimo-flash-effort.md; Xiaomi docs re-read 2026-11-01, mimo/). Vals records reasoning, reasoning_effort and compute_effort as null and its MiMo-V2.6-Flash model page (read 2026-10-30) states no reasoning setting; it stays unmatched under O140. New evidence for the owner: Vals' MiMo-V2.6-Pro model page (vals/_models/xiaomi_mimo-v2.6-pro.html, read 2026-11-01), in its 2026-09-22 update covering both models, says 'We evaluated them with reasoning enabled' through the official Xiaomi API.

kimi-k3-1-pro.note: Owner decision O66 (2026-10-25): AA plots Kimi K3.1 Pro without an effort; Moonshot's API documents reasoning_effort low / high / max with max the default, so its configuration is taken at max, its maximum effort.

mimo-v2-6-pro.note: Owner decision O54 / E252: AA plots MiMo-V2.6-Pro without an effort; Xiaomi documents one thinking mode for mimo-v2.6-pro (thinking.type enabled/disabled, default enabled; re-read 2026-11-01, mimo/), so the configuration is thinking enabled, which the owner labels high: a source row labelled high, or stating reasoning enabled, is that configuration. Vals records reasoning, reasoning_effort and compute_effort as null; its model page (read 2026-11-01) says of MiMo V2.6 Pro and Flash 'We evaluated them with reasoning enabled' through the official Xiaomi API (2026-09-22 update).

minimax-m3-1-flash.note: Owner decision O135 (2026-10-30) applied to MiniMax-M3.1-Flash: AA plots it without an effort; MiniMax's API documents reasoning_effort / output_config.effort low, medium, high, xhigh, max with max the default when omitted, and thinking cannot be disabled (minimax-effort.md, read 2026-11-01), so the configuration is max. The O135 research outcome for MiniMax awaits the owner's confirmation (as O140 confirmed MiMo-V2.6-Flash). Vals' model page (read 2026-11-01): run 'via the official MiniMax API at temperature 1, top_p 0.95, compute effort max'.
